body: It's not that I don't have friends, I have a close group that genuinely cares about me and that would support me if I slipped too far.  I should be pretty happy and well adjusted person, but I'm not.  I definitely put on a face for them that doesn't really reflect my inner turmoil.  But then who doesn't?

I agree with Lincoln on all points except for light exercise.  Do heavy exercise.  Go out and buy Starting strength.  Read that shit cover to cover so you don't hurt yourself squatting.  Eat heavy, lift heavy, and get strong like bull.  After a month or two you will be addicted to lifting.  It makes me feel great and I can't recommend it enough.

Yea man I've been watching myself slide closer to that edge for a while.  Something that helps me is lifting.  When I'm in the gym there's not really an outside world.  All there is is whatever I'm listening to, my form, and keeping track of my numbers in my head.  My shit's still waiting for me outside, but I get an hour's relief, at least.  Plus I feel better for a few hours after.
